content: Edit file: in visit_literal for inline code with language, replace the separate appends (`\sphinxcode{`, `\sphinxupquote{`, `\n`, `}}`) with appending `\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{%...%}` at open and keeping `}}` at close; need `rstrip()` (already done after slicing) to remove trailing newline, and strip any leading whitespace before the first `%`. Content lines from Pygments are flush-left, so leading whitespace likely none. Other branches: visit_desc_inline and plain literal (no language) do not use highlighter/have no leading/trailing whitespace, but could add `%` there too for safety; decision deferred. Do not change `self.body.append('}}')`. Next: find exact lines and edit.
